classify one reviewed CI23p source-income nonresponse field

Source: R/liss_source_nonresponse.R
liss_classify_source_nonresponse.Rd

Bind one explicitly selected column to the exact, reviewed local SAV source. The returned data retain their values and metadata. The separate carrier records typed source nonresponse and prohibits numerical proposals for the matched household cells when consumed by liss_clean_income(). The default schema-1 recipe covers ci23p339 = -9999999999. An explicit schema-2 recipe selects either ci23p337 or ci23p338, with exact codes -9999999999 and -9999999998 under one field receipt. Taxable fields have no household-cleaner approval. One classifier call selects one field. An explicit schema-3 guarded module merge can carry both taxable fields in one complete collection; this scalar classifier rejects schemas 3 and 4 and every existing collection lineage.

Usage

liss_classify_source_nonresponse(
  data,
  source,
  target,
  wave_col = NULL,
  id_col = "nomem_encr",
  recipe = NULL
)

Arguments

data

a data frame, or a merge result containing data.

source

path to the reviewed ci23p_EN_1.0p.sav file. Its filename and SHA256 must match the contract; a caller-provided hash is insufficient.

target

one explicitly selected column. Raw binding without a wave column requires the selected exact raw name. A merged binding requires an explicit wave column and unchanged values under unique respondent keys. Supported household targets are ci23p339, s339, ci_s339, nethh and ci00a339. Taxable targets are only the selected ci23p337/s337/ ci_s337 or ci23p338/s338/ci_s338 names; aliases do not select a field or establish source ownership.

wave_col

optional column containing exact wave identifiers. Only rows equal to ci23p are evaluated, but every presented row must have a nonmissing, nonempty exact wave identifier. Years alone are insufficient. Full-join panels with CI-absent rows lacking CI wave identity are unsupported.

id_col

respondent-key column, default nomem_encr.

recipe

optional parsed CI recipe or recipe path. Its contract must match the complete typed contract in the package-owned, digest-pinned reviewed registry. Recipes cannot approve new scope. The installed CI recipe is used by default and selects the existing household contract. Consumer approval is checked separately before numerical preparation. Schema 2.0.0 requires only schema_version and one complete reviewed field record. Existing version-1 carriers retain their original rule and scalar shape. Taxable bindings require unguarded inputs; rebinding any taxable carrier is unsupported, including a reverse household binding. Schema-3 taxable pairs and schema-4 mixed three-field collections are available only through an explicitly guarded module merge. A separate package-owned consumer policy permits explicit household339 flag simulation on an intact schema-4 collection while retaining all three fields and complete lineage. This scalar classifier provides no collection projection or declassification.

Value

a liss_source_nonresponse_result with unchanged data and a source_nonresponse carrier containing the source receipt, original metadata, cell ledger, coverage, readiness and serialization digest. Retain this complete wrapper. RDS preserves the carrier. SAV/CSV alone do not preserve readiness; reimport requires a new explicit verified source binding.

Details

For household classification, pass the complete result to liss_clean_income(). The classifier does not add a frame marker to its unchanged $data; extracting an unmarked frame and cleaning it alone enters ordinary unguarded processing. Keep the original merge result separately when rebinding, because its provenance, log and validation fields are not copied into the classifier result.

In flag mode the actual supplied target remains unchanged, including missing analysis amounts from a guarded merge. Verified source originals are retained in the cleaner's _observed audit column and source ledger; matched proposals stay missing. Readiness covers only this source/field contract, not the suitability of every audit column for analysis. A source-bound household amount cannot also serve as the cleaner's category_code.

Reordering and subsets require retained column metadata and the complete carrier, as with supported tibble/dplyr operations. Base data-frame operations that strip target attributes fail closed. Validation does not relax metadata checks to accommodate such operations.

Serialized object hashes use profile 1.0.0: SHA-256 over XDR version-2 R serialization with only the writer-version header fixed to R 4.6.1. All payload bytes remain significant; raw file hashes are unchanged. Compatibility covers the R 4.6.1 reference profile, not arbitrary historical writers or future serialization bodies. Other legacy profiles require their original package/runtime. Reference identity checks remain separate from digests.
